speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Before I proceed to start the electronic voting, may I remind Members that they are to be seated at the designated seats and should only start to vote when the voting buttons on the armrest start to blink.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Members are advised to check that their names have been registered according to the vote indication when the voting results are shown on the display screens.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Before I proceed to declare the results of the vote, are there any Members who wish to claim that his or her vote has not been displayed or displayed incorrectly on the screens?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Now, Sir, I beg to move, "That the Bill be now read a Third time."

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Again, reminder to Members to depress their vote button firmly in order to register their vote in the system.
